title: Private Antelope Island & Great Salt Lake Tour
includes: The guide also serves as the driver.
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us for an unforgettable tour of Antelope Island, a stunning gem in the Great Salt Lake! Discover breathtaking landscapes, spot free-roaming bison, and explore picturesque hiking trails. Learn about the island's unique ecology and history while enjoying panoramic views of the lake and surrounding mountains. Perfect for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike, this tour promises a memorable experience in Utah’s natural beauty!
